sync.title: Folder Sync
sync.description: Automatically sync local folders with Telegram channels.
sync.off_by_default: Folder Sync is off by default
sync.onboarding: Nothing is synchronized until you enable it. Files over 2 GB are skipped, and large deletion bursts pause the sync for your protection.
sync.mapper_description: Map each local folder to one existing Telegram channel.
sync.no_channels: Refresh your Telegram folders before creating a sync mapping.

settings.title: Pengaturan
settings.desktop_background_mode_desc: Lanjutkan transfer dari baki sistem sampai Telegram Drive ditutup secara eksplisit.
settings.desktop_background_hint: Telegram Drive tetap berjalan di baki sistem. Gunakan Keluar dari baki untuk menghentikannya.
settings.desktop_notifications_desc: Terima peringatan sistem privat untuk aktivitas transfer.
settings.desktop_notifications_unavailable: Notifikasi desktop tidak tersedia di sistem ini.
settings.desktop_notify_visible: Beri tahu saat Telegram Drive terbuka
settings.desktop_notify_visible_desc: Tampilkan juga notifikasi saat jendela utama aktif.
settings.desktop_notification_filenames_desc: Nama file dapat terlihat di layar kunci. Nonaktif lebih privat.
settings.video_upload_desc: Media mengaktifkan pratinjau Telegram untuk MP4, M4V, dan MOV. Video terlindungi selalu menggunakan File.
settings.linux_rendering_desc: Disable DMA-BUF renderer (fixes GPU crashes, requires restart)
settings.enable_api_server_desc: Start API server to access files programmatically
settings.api_copy_alert: Copy now — this key will not be shown again
settings.transcode_cache_desc: Max disk space for HLS variants
settings.enable_proxy_desc: Route traffic through a proxy server
settings.socks5_desc: SOCKS5 proxy (MTProto not supported by grammers)
settings.proxy_reconnect_note: ⚠️ Proxy changes require reconnecting to take effect.
settings.dc_fallback_desc: DCs to try on connection failure
settings.bulk_archive_desc: Max RAM for API archive downloads
settings.ip_override_desc: Automatically replaces '127.0.0.1:14201' with this IP/domain when copying.
settings.no_active_links_desc: Right-click any file and select "Share Link" to create one.
settings.tagline: Turn your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Open-source and free forever.
settings.clear_local_cache_desc: Remove cached previews and temp files
settings.clear_cache_desc: This will remove all cached previews and temporary files. Your uploaded files on Telegram are not affected.
settings.clear_transcode_message: This will delete all transcoded HLS variants and cached originals. Files will need to be re-transcoded for HLS playback.
settings.ffmpeg_required_desc: FFmpeg tidak terdeteksi. Video akan menggunakan streaming asli dan Cache Transkode akan tetap kosong.
settings.ffmpeg_restart_hint: Instal versi Windows, tambahkan folder yang berisi ffmpeg.exe ke PATH, lalu mulai ulang Telegram Drive.
settings.check_updates_desc: Check if a newer version exists
settings.update_prod_only_toast: Update check is only available in production builds
settings.revoke_link_desc: Are you sure you want to revoke this link? Anyone using it will no longer be able to download the file.
settings.regenerate_api_key_desc: This will revoke your current API key and generate a new one. Any existing integrations will stop working.
settings.generate_api_key_desc: Generate a new API key for authenticating REST API requests.
settings.restart_app_toast: Restart the app for this change to take effect
settings.reconnect_success_toast: Reconnected successfully with new proxy settings
settings.http_bridge_desc: HTTP/HTTPS proxy tunneling via local SOCKS5 bridge.
settings.live_state_desc: Periodically check connectivity and display latency
settings.delete_theme_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this custom theme?
settings.encryption_unavailable: Enkripsi tidak tersedia dalam versi ini.
settings.encryption_backend_error: Layanan enkripsi tidak merespons. Proses aplikasi lama mungkin masih berjalan.
settings.encryption_safety_pause_body: Transfer standar tetap tersedia. Unggahan terenkripsi dan dekripsi dinonaktifkan sampai format yang diperbaiki dan brankas persisten siap.
settings.encryption_disabled: Enkripsi dimatikan. Transfer standar tetap tersedia.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_one: Satu file terenkripsi eksperimental terindeks secara lokal. Teks sandinya dipertahankan.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_other: {{count}} file terenkripsi eksperimental terindeks secara lokal. Teks sandinya dipertahankan.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_body: Telegram Drive tidak dapat memulihkan atau mengatur ulang frasa sandi, kunci enkripsi, atau materi pemulihan yang terlupa. Jika Anda kehilangan semua kredensial yang dapat membuka file, file itu mungkin tidak dapat diakses secara permanen. Simpan materi pemulihan dengan aman, pertahankan cadangan yang telah diverifikasi, dan jangan bagikan kredensial kepada orang yang tidak Anda percayai.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_acknowledgement: Saya memahami bahwa saya bertanggung jawab melindungi kredensial enkripsi dan kehilangan semua kredensial yang valid dapat menghalangi akses ke file terenkripsi saya secara permanen.
settings.encryption_ack_required: Konfirmasikan peringatan kehilangan kunci sebelum membuat brankas.
settings.default_upload_protection_desc: Pilih cara file baru dilindungi secara bawaan
settings.protect_metadata_desc: Sembunyikan nama asli dan jenis MIME
settings.auto_lock_vault_desc: Kunci setelah tidak aktif selama beberapa waktu
settings.lock_on_sleep_desc: Kunci brankas saat aplikasi masuk ke latar belakang
settings.temp_plaintext_policy_desc: Mode ketat memblokir file teks biasa sementara di disk
settings.vault_create_prompt: Buat brankas untuk mengaktifkan unggahan terenkripsi. Pilih frasa sandi kuat yang dapat Anda ingat.
settings.recovery_key_warning: Simpan kunci ini dengan aman. Kunci tidak dapat dipulihkan jika hilang.
settings.vault_is_unlocked: Brankas terbuka. File dapat dienkripsi dan didekripsi.
settings.vault_is_locked: Brankas terkunci. Buka untuk mengakses file terenkripsi.
settings.export_recovery_desc: Buat cadangan terenkripsi dari kunci brankas dan simpan dengan aman.
settings.bundle_warning: Paket ini berisi kunci brankas terenkripsi. Simpan dengan aman dan jangan pernah membagikannya.
settings.import_recovery_desc: Pulihkan brankas dari paket pemulihan terenkripsi.
settings.import_recovery_confirmation: Impor akan mengganti brankas saat ini setelah paket dan frasa sandi diverifikasi. Lanjutkan?
settings.webdav_description: Open Telegram Drive in Finder, File Explorer, or another WebDAV client.
settings.webdav_local_only: The server listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1).
settings.webdav_allow_changes_desc: Allow WebDAV clients to upload, rename, move, and delete unencrypted files. Leave off for safer read-only access.
settings.webdav_link_configured: Secure link configured. Regenerate it if you no longer have a copy.
settings.webdav_link_unset: Generate a private connection link before enabling the server.
settings.webdav_copy_alert: Copy now — this private link will not be shown again
settings.webdav_changes_enabled: Current access: file changes are allowed
settings.webdav_mobile_unavailable: WebDAV hosting is available in the macOS, Windows, and Linux desktop apps.
settings.webdav_regenerate_desc: The current connection link will stop working immediately. You will need to reconnect every WebDAV client with the new link.
settings.webdav_enable_changes_confirm: Connected WebDAV clients will be able to upload, rename, move, and delete unencrypted files. Encrypted files remain protected.
settings.offline_cache_desc: File tanpa enkripsi yang baru dibuka disimpan di perangkat ini untuk akses offline.
settings.clear_offline_cache_desc: File yang disimpan untuk akses offline akan dihapus dari perangkat ini. Salinan di Telegram tidak terpengaruh.

files.no_other_folders: Tidak ada folder lain yang tersedia. Buatlah terlebih dahulu!
files.url_must_start: URL harus dimulai dengan http:// atau https://
files.transfers_queue_desc: Unduhan dan unggahan diantrekan secara aman di latar belakang.
files.drop_browser_help: Gunakan aplikasi desktop untuk melepas file atau buka dialog unggah.

notifications.drop_rejected_one: {{count}} item yang dilepas dilewati. Lepaskan file biasa atau gunakan Unggah Folder.
notifications.drop_rejected_other: {{count}} item yang dilepas dilewati. Lepaskan file biasa atau gunakan Unggah Folder.

share.tailscale_help: To share with someone else on your Tailscale network or local WiFi, enter your machine's IP address or hostname below:

auth.desktop_required_desc: You are viewing the internal development server in a browser. This application cannot function here because it requires access to the system backend (Rust).
auth.open_window_prompt: Please open the Telegram Drive window in your OS taskbar/dock to continue.
auth.flood_wait_msg: Telegram has temporarily limited your actions.
auth.timer_reset_warning: Do not restart the app. The timer will reset if you do.
auth.how_to_get_credentials: How do I get my API credentials?
auth.two_factor_enabled: Your account has Two-Factor Authentication enabled. Please enter your cloud password to continue.
auth.privacy_note: Your credentials are stored locally on your device and are never sent to any third-party servers. All data goes directly between you and Telegram.
auth.code_sent_telegram_app: Telegram mengirim kode masuk ke obrolan Telegram terverifikasi di salah satu perangkat Anda yang sudah masuk.
auth.code_sent_sms: Telegram mengirim kode masuk melalui SMS.
auth.code_sent_call: Telegram akan menelepon dan membacakan kode masuk.
auth.code_sent_flash_call: Telegram akan melakukan panggilan singkat. Masukkan nomor penelepon yang cocok dengan {{hint}}.
auth.code_sent_missed_call: Telegram akan melakukan panggilan tak terjawab. Masukkan digit terakhir dari nomor yang diawali {{hint}}.
auth.code_sent_fragment: Telegram mengirim kode ini melalui Fragment. Buka Fragment untuk mengambilnya.
auth.code_sent_sms_word: Telegram mengirim SMS berisi kata yang diawali {{hint}}. Masukkan kata lengkapnya.
auth.code_sent_sms_phrase: Telegram mengirim SMS berisi frasa yang diawali {{hint}}. Masukkan frasa lengkapnya.
auth.code_delivery_unsupported: Telegram memilih metode pengiriman yang tidak dapat diselesaikan oleh aplikasi desktop pihak ketiga. Gunakan login QR.
auth.fragment_url_invalid: Telegram mengembalikan tautan masuk Fragment yang tidak valid.
